name: sc-skills
description: Seurat-first Claude Code skills for single-cell RNA-seq: catalog and retrieval, CellBender/decontX preprocessing, Harmony/scVI/scGPT integration, marker-verified annotation, sample-level DE and differential abundance, trajectory, CellChat, GRN, spatial, Perturb-seq, and target prioritisation, plus R-first publication figures under a shared conventions and reproducibility contract. The single-cell skill routes; sc-paper-distill grows the suite from the literature.
